Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:34619

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6497 of 2023

Applicant :- Bablu Rawat Alias Babu
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Addl. Chief Secty. Deptt. Of Home Govt. Of U.P Civi

Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar,Anil Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Anil Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Vipul Gupta, learned A.G.A.
for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
445 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from
Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Tikaitnagar, District Barabanki.

entities.text:
Protection of Children from
Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 29.11.2022 stating that the informant's daughter had eloped with the help of the applicant.

4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she has stated that the informant was attempting to get her married to a person whom she does not like and for this reason she had gone away from her house and she has married the applicant.

The age of the victim is said to be about 17 years.

sentences.text: In the pathological examination report no spermatozoa or gonococci has been seen in the vaginal smear of the victim.
6. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. also she reiterated her earlier version.

7. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
8.
The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the victim has consistently stated that she has gone with the applicant out of her own freewill and she has married him and that the applicant is aged about 20 years and it cannot be expected that the persons of young age, in love with each other would be able to ascertain correct age of the partner from her physical appearance only coupled with the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 02.12.2022 and without making any observation,
which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
10. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
